Work, parent-candidate, related-candidate and second-work Matters (type Advisory), a Confidential Matter created and related by the other legal role, and two NDAs were created through the API as fixtures; closing, reopening, archiving and restoring the work Matter and Tom Iwu leaving the team were fixture actions through the API.
scenarios.expected: Tasks, Key dates, Matter relationships, and linked Contracts remain distinct and accurate, and History records the changes. Invalid hierarchy loops, restricted targets, and unauthorized changes do not expose or alter hidden work.
scenarios.actual: 17 recorded browser steps passed for this role (run 1790333890346) on work Matter M-96 with Jonas Weber (Business User) on the team. Add Task refused a missing title ("Name what needs doing."); a person staged with Use this person was discarded by Cancel. The Add a Task dialog had Comments & attachments with Add a note and no audience controls; Add Task saved the Task, Tom Iwu's membership and assignment, and the note on the Task conversation only. Add to team and assign on a row saved at once; Unassigned kept the membership; Close in Task details discarded a staged person. Tasks listed by due date with the undated one last; a done Task hid until Show completed and reopened from there; Edit Task and Save renamed a row and the count read "0 of 3 done". Task details showed "Visible to everyone who can access this task." with no audience selector. Remove Task removed an empty Task and refused a Task with a conversation ("This Task has a conversation on it, so it cannot be removed. Mark it done instead."), also after its only comment was deleted. A failed initial note (browser-route stand-in) kept the dialog with Retry note & attachments and the retry made one Task with one comment. Add date refused a missing Date and Event; Reminders showed "Global reminders: 30 days before, 14 days before, 7 days before, 1 day before, On the day" and "This date will remind:" with the added lead time; 731 was refused, 0 read "On the day" and the 21st lead time was refused; Recipients listed the team including Jonas Weber. The header read "2 upcoming · 1 overdue" and the tab "Key dates 2". After Tom Iwu left the team the dialog said "Some selected recipients have left the team and will not be reminded.", offered Remove unavailable recipients when others remained and only Use the usual audience when none did. Edit date saved; Remove date asked "Remove Key date?"; a closed Matter kept editable dates and had no Next deadline until reopened. A Needed by date set on Overview appeared as a Key date named Needed by with Edit date and Remove date, and editing it moved the Overview Row. Set parent (Cancel, then confirm) showed Parent and Change parent; the reverse parent was refused with "That parent would close a loop in the Matter hierarchy."; the search found candidates by title and by bare number (typing "M-…" listed 0 and the digits 1). Add related Matter showed the relation on both Matters and Remove deleted only the link; New sub-Matter showed "Parent:" and made a child that copied no Manager, team, Tasks or flag; Remove on the child's Parent row detached it. Confidential M-100, related by the other legal role, showed as "Restricted Matter" with no title or link, its read answered 404, History did not name it, and this reader's Task and relation writes on it answered 404. Linking a Confidential NDA showed Confidentiality differs with Leave them as they are and changed neither flag; the other legal role saw "Restricted contract". A second Matter link was refused (409) until Unlink; New contract opened Create contract with this Matter chosen; an archived linked Contract left the card while the link stayed. Settings > Notifications showed the Reminder lead times card. Archived, the Matter had no Add Task, Add date or relationship controls and writes answered 409; restored, its rows remained and History listed Task, Key date, status and relation changes. Jonas Weber was sent from the Tasks tab to /portal and his Task, Key date and relation writes answered 403.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
Upload and comment failures were browser-route stand-ins (route.abort) for network failures.

The work2 lab is shared with other DOC-030 agents. The magic-link budget (3 per address, 30 per client address in 15 minutes) is shared by all of them; the script waited out 429s and reused one Business User session per run.

Administrator and Legal Team Member have the same controls here. Unauthorized changes were checked on a Confidential Matter this reader does not reach (404 on Task and relation writes) and for the Business User (403).
Reminder delivery, the Portal bell and email for Business Users, and a person's own Reminder lead times list were not exercised; the card was only opened. notifications.md covers delivery.
The relation search does not accept the M- prefix and does not rank an exact number first; both are recorded as productBugs in walkthrough.json. The guide's search by M-number works with the digits.
Renaming the Needed by Key date's Event, which detaches it from the Overview Row, was not exercised; the guide does not describe it.

compatibilityReview.summary: From 067c1646 to 4ca41822 (DOC-032, set compat-b): I read the diff of matter-record.tsx, task-assignment.ts, the new lib/matter-team.ts, matters/routes.ts, matters/service.ts and messages/en-US.json. The Matter Tasks, Key dates, Related Matters and Linked Contracts cards, the task dialog and assignee picker, and the matter-tasks and matter-relations routes did not change. 254d4d40 makes a Task assignee team add call addMatterTeamMember, which inserts the same matter_team row and writes the same matter.team_added entry as before; the Matter team routes and the Business Owner change use the same helper. matter-record.tsx only moved the Matter Manager and Business Owner controls into a new Owners section, which this guide does not place. I replayed the DOC-030 matter-work script for Administrator and Legal Team Member on work built from 4ca41822; all 34 steps passed, 17 per role, as in DOC-030; from 4ca41822 to ad345da5 (bridge): I read the whole app diff. None. No hunk reaches a claim of this guide: the range changes only version strings, comments, tests, the unused message catalog, the build tool turbo, and nodemailer and sharp patch releases. The guide makes no claim about the app version, email content or delivery, or organization logo processing, and its recorded steps read no mail and save no logo. No statement changed.
